summary: Iteration 32 — E2E test of (1) BUG FIX: VOR vehicles excluded from compliance score, (2) FEATURE: Sold/Disposed vehicles (endpoint, badge, exclusion), (3) FEATURE: 18-month Records Retention 'Off-road / sold vehicles' category, (4) FEATURE: Trailer Sold checkbox/badge, and (5) REGRESSION: PDF escaping (& < >) + licence-check headline recompute. Backend pytest tests/test_iter32_vor_sold.py = 7 passed, 1 skipped (viewer-guard: no self role change endpoint, but earlier iterations verified this). Frontend Playwright E2E on the deployed preview URL confirms: sold-button opens dialog with sold-date/sold-notes/save-sold-button, saving shows sold-badge and swaps VOR/Sold action buttons for restore-sold-button, dashboard Records Retention shows the 'Off-road / sold vehicles' category (5 categories total), Trailers tab Add form reveals trl-sold-date/trl-sold-notes when trl-sold is checked, and VOR button flow still works showing vor-badge + clear-vor-button.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py gather_stats (~line 3995, 4029, 4044, 4204) correctly skips vehicles/trailers where sold=True OR vor=True; vor_regs set unions sold regs so PMI/wheel loops skip them.

server.py POST /api/vehicles/{vid}/sold clears any prior VOR calendar events (delete_many ref in [vor:{vid}, sold:{vid}]) and stores sold_date+sold_notes with a keep_until = sold_date + 18 months. Reverse endpoint /sold/clear also removes the calendar event.
server.py records_retention (~line 2488-2518) 'Off-road / sold vehicles' category retention_months=18; items derive base date from sold_date (or vor_off_date) then compute eligibility.

Frontend Vehicles.js: sold-button and vor-button are correctly hidden when the row is sold (line 146-148 uses ternary v.sold ? restore-sold-button : (v.vor ? clear-vor-button : [vor-button, sold-button])). Verified in the UI: only 1 vor-button remaining after marking one of two vehicles sold.
Frontend Trailers.js trl-sold checkbox correctly reveals trl-sold-date + trl-sold-notes when checked; trailer-sold-badge exists on sold trailer rows.
